name: The Honeyed Hand
summary: Advantage on Persuasion, and Charm Monster once per long rest. The price: Disadvantage on saves against being Charmed, and no will to refuse a pleasure.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's; the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_faceless_god (the ring of amber).

benefit.text: You know what people want before they do, and you know how to look as if you are offering it.

cost.flaw: You cannot turn down a pleasure that is offered to you. You can only be talked out of it afterward.
cost.text: What you can do to others is easier to do to you. Charms, glamours and sweet voices find the door already open.
